completion_rule: Every required depth must cover the declared feature set with result_status AE exact; the plug-in must also be host-stable with complete binary-grounded IR. 32bpc additionally requires float-preserving references.

excluded.reason: Support/helper only; not part of the OLM compatibility release target unless explicitly promoted in the ledger.
